info.name: Gamification API
info.description: This API has build to give you a simple way to add gamification to your project. You can manage players and give points and badges to players when some events raises.EndFragment

item.name: Application

request.description:
This is the first thing you must do to use this API.

Give a name, a description and a unique key and a secure password. The application id is return.

**Response**

- 201
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
  "status": "created",
  "url": "/application/{id}"
}

 ```

Return the name, description and the key of an application. You must provide the apiKey and apiPassword in the http header.

**Response**

- 201
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{ 
    "name":"", 
    "description":"", 
    "apiKey": "", 
}

 ```

You can update all informations of your application (including apiKey and apiPassword).

**Response**

- 200

header.name: cache-control
header.info:
Postman added "Cache-Control: no-cache" as a precautionary measure to prevent the server from returning stale response when one makes repeated requests.

You can remove this header in the app settings or enter a new one with a different value.

header.name: postman-token
header.info:
The Postman-Token header appends a random UUID to every outgoing request. Postman adds this header for API developers to better debug requests sent and to ensure separate requests appear distinct to the receiving server.

You can remove this header in the app settings.

header.name: host
header.info:
The Host header is added to identify the domain name for which a request is being sent to the server. This header is implicitly sent by every HTTP client.

You can remove the header or enter a new one with a different value. It is most likely that without this header, your request will return an HTTP 400 error.

header.name: user-agent
header.info:
The User-Agent header is added to help the server identify Postman as the HTTP requesting application or client.

It is recommended that this header be sent, but you can remove the header or enter a new one with a different value.

header.name: accept
header.info:
The "Accept: */*" header is added to tell the server that Postman can understand and process all forms of response content types.

It is recommended that this header be sent, but you can remove the header or enter a new one with a different value.

header.name: accept-encoding
header.info:
The Accept-Encoding header is added to indicate to the server that Postman HTTP client supports a defined list of content-encoding or compression algorithms as response.

You can remove the header or enter a new one with a different value. Doing that may not accurately render the response within the app.

header.name: connection
header.info:
Postman added the Connection header to indicate the server to keep the underlying network connection open once the current response is received. This allows Postman to reuse the same connection for faster response times in subsequent requests to the same server.

You can remove this header or enter a new one with a different value, such as `Connection: Close` to control this behaviour.

item.name: Players

request.description:
Return the list of all players of an application.

**Response**

- 200
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
    "id": ,
    "firstName": "",
    "lastName": "",
    "email": "",
    "numberOfPoints": ,
    "badges": [
        "id": ,
        "name":"",
        "description": "",
        "icon": ""
    ]
}

 ```

Create a new player with his basic informations. Return the new player's id.

_To manage points and badges, please go to events resources_

**Response**

- 201
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
  "status": "created",
  "url": "/players/{id}"
}

 ```

Return the detail of a player, including the numberOfPoints and list of all his badges.

**Response**

- 200
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
    "id": ,
    "firstName": "",
    "lastName": "",
    "email": "",
    "numberOfPoints": ,
    "badges": [
        "id": ,
        "name":"",
        "description": "",
        "icon": ""
    ]
}

 ```

Update basic informations of a player.

_The points and badges can only be updated by events._

**Response**

- 200

Delete a player, all events link to a player will be deleted in cascade.

**Response**

- 200

item.description: The player is an user of the application. He can win points and badges when events happening.

item.name: Badges

**Response**

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
    "items":
    [
        "id": ,
        "name":"",
        "description": "",
        "icon": ""
    ]
}

 ```

Create a new badge with the path to an icon representing the badge.

**Response**

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
  "status": "created",
  "url": "/badges/{id}"
}

 ```

Return all details of a badge.

**Response**

- 200
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
    "id": ,
    "name": "",
    "description": "",
    "icon": ""
}
 ```

- 200

Delete a badge, all link to this badge by rules will be set to null.

**Response**

- 200

item.description: A badge is a distinction, win by a player when he does something significant (on event).

item.name: Rules

request.description:
Return the list of all rules of an application.

**Response**

- 200
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
    "items":
    [
        "id": ,
        "badgeId": ,
        "numberOfPoints": ,
        "onEventType": ""
    ]
}

 ```

Add a new rule, the badgeId is optional, the numberOfPoints is required but he can be set to 0. Return the new rule's id.

**Response**

- 201
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
  "status": "created",
  "url": "/rules/{id}"
}

 ```

Return the details of a rule.

**Response**

- 200
    

HEADERS

- Content-Type:application/json
    

BODY

``` json
{
    "id": ,
    "badgeId": ,
    "numberOfPoints": ,
    "onEventType": ""
}

 ```

Update a rule, this doesn't change badges and points give to players on past events.

**Response**

- 200

Delete a rule, this doesn't remove badges and points give to players on past events.

**Response**

- 200

item.description: A rule determine how many points or/and which badge can be win by a player on an event type. Many rules can be create for the same event type.
